source: Customized snapshot of the original MacShell topbar
scope: Topbar and Control Centre (MacBar.qml and its private dependencies)
integration_changes: Separate shader cache filename to avoid reusing modified dock shaders
Explicit zero default for the existing flatInner shader uniform
Use the existing desktop WidgetVisual when mirroring widgets into the topbar backdrop
customizations: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Sound and Notification Center match the File/Edit LGlass and MenuBorder parameters (42 px blur, 14 px corners, matching tint, rim and refraction).
Restored Spotlight gooey opening, staggered button separation, shared silhouette shader and surface handoff from the pre-reinstall configuration.
Spotlight uses one inset border with no drop shadow, hover halo or duplicate outlines; the gooey shader uses the same border-only material.
